title: Resuming a finished reviewer is refused, and the refusal says to send a fresh reviewer the prior report
why: A SendMessage resume of a finished reviewer runs with no worktree and on the parent's model. Rule roles-resume-by-name says to send a fresh reviewer the prior report instead. Three incidents on Nov 7.
note: Topic guards. From a note of lane resumed-agent-stale-tree, made a step by the coordinator at 20:28 CST Nov 7 (3 incidents today); started in lane session_013NEJL3qSsV2LJ6R1a1HMCB the same minute. No earlier step held it (resume-lost-worktree covers a top-level session). Filed 20:30 CST Nov 7. Widening sighting (lane other-checkout-cp-own (session_013NEJL3R2CBFavz7grtbJY8); coordinator, 04:13 CST Nov 8): a resumed builder or test-author whose isolation worktree was reaped stops at worktree-home too; rule roles-resume-by-name names only the reviewer case. The rule text change is owner rule text: page item 409. Owner item 409 a (06:11 CST Nov 8): rule roles-resume-by-name covers any finished agent whose worktree is gone ("send a fresh agent of the same role the prior report instead"); this step widens its refusal to match. Items 409 a (a rule-text follow-up PR) and 412 a (the probe, waiting on the owner's typed grant in this lane's chat, page task 414) ride in this lane, after #1917 (coordinator, 06:16 CST Nov 8). Two more sightings (coordinator 13:17 CST Nov 8, proposed step reviewer-resume-refused): lane message-time-matches-clock (session_013NEJL1PfmnFVDD3X2P28Kk) resumed a finished reviewer whose worktree was gone with SendMessage, twice today, and nothing refused it. Rule roles-resume-by-name says to send a fresh reviewer the prior report. Sighting (lane sim-tool-lease-check, session_013NEJL2ZJUtVxqpKrEjh7X2, via coordinator 13:55 CST Nov 8): resuming an agent by name fails once its worktree is gone. Sighting (lane revive-1042, session_013NEJL2GCahFnLKLzmw1JAM, 15:09 CST Nov 8): a resume by name fails for any finished agent whose worktree is gone, not only a reviewer; the lane had to spawn a fresh agent with the prior report. Rule roles-resume-by-name names reviewers only. The lane confirms whether the refusal covers every role.
